remarks: Exceptional opportunity to lease a beautifully updated three-bedroom, one-and-a-half bath duplex just moments from the heart of New Canaan. Enjoy the convenience of a walk-to-town lifestyle paired with the privacy of your own deck and backyard. A finished lower level offers versatile living space, while abundant storage adds everyday ease. Stylish, inviting, and rarely available at this price point, this is a rental opportunity not to be missed.
